# Earnings Calendar and Analysis for This Week (September 7-11)

Check out our earnings calendar for this week, as well as our previews and recaps of the more noteworthy reports.

Karee Venema's avatar

By Karee Venema   Edited by David Dittman 

Last updated   In News

Calendar with numerous dates marked with pushpins.  

(Image credit: Getty Images)

Jump to category: [...] ### Monday (9/7)

The stock and bond markets are closed on Monday, September 7, in observance of Labor Day.

There are no noteworthy earnings reports scheduled for release.

Noteworthy after-the-close earnings reports [...] We'll see how Kroger measures up when management reports fiscal second-quarter results before the closing bell on Friday. Wall Street expects EPS of $1.06 (+1.9% YoY) on revenue of $34.61 billion (+2.0% YoY).

Note that Kroger is the only noteworthy publicly traded company scheduled to report earnings on Friday, September 11.
